methodology.pageDescription: The complete measurement pipeline behind the Yagoo-dori tier list: the team utility model, matched substitution, the four card metrics, the index scale, and the tier boundaries.
methodology.headline: Cards are measured inside teams.
methodology.intro: This page is the whole pipeline, with the arithmetic left in. Every tier letter on this site is produced by the steps below from pinned card data, a frozen chart benchmark, and a fixed set of comparison contexts. Nothing is hand-placed and nothing is voted on.
methodology.pipelineTitle: The measurement pipeline, from a single card kit through to a published tier letter
methodology.pipelineCaption: Each stage is deterministic. Given the same pinned data, the same card produces the same letter every time.
methodology.stepOneHeadline: What a team is worth on one chart
methodology.stepTwoHeadline: Why every number arrives as a range
methodology.stepThreeHeadline: What a card's ranking actually compares
methodology.stepSix: Step six — the part people ask about
methodology.stepSixHeadline: Why nothing on this site is rated SS or D
methodology.stepReadingHeadline: What this measurement does not tell you
methodology.stepProvenanceHeadline: What this run was pinned to
methodology.metricGFormula: G = mean( mᵢ ) over every matched context i
methodology.metricGDetail: The plain average of the card's matched-substitution value. A card that helps a little almost everywhere ranks well here.
methodology.metricPFormula: P = mean of the highest ⌈n/10⌉ values of mᵢ
methodology.metricPDetail: The average of the strongest tenth of contexts, not a single lucky team. This is where cards that need a specific partner earn their place. Each of the three lanes is ranked separately, so they can describe different subsets of contexts.
methodology.metricBFormula: B = share of contexts where u_candidate ≥ 0.95 · max( u_candidate, u_alternatives )
methodology.metricBDetail: How often the card lands within 5% of the strongest option available in that context. Note this metric compares team utilities rather than the marginal above, and the comparison pool includes the card itself, so a card that is the strongest option counts here.
methodology.metricEDetail: The trapezoidal mean of general value across three model progression states — entry level, one-copy maximum, and the duplicate-enabled ceiling — so cards that arrive useful are separated from cards that need heavy investment. The x-axis is those model states, not a real resource or copy cost, which is why this is named progression value rather than cost efficiency. Being a mean across all three progression states, E is identical on all three lenses.
methodology.laneLowerRule: Skills overlap completely; only the strongest one counts, and no activation-rate help is assumed.
methodology.laneLowerTargeting: Every unresolved skill target resolves to the least favourable recipient.
methodology.laneCentralRule: Skills activate independently and the strongest active one is selected, evaluated as an exact expectation.
methodology.laneCentralTargeting: Unresolved stat-effect targets still resolve to the guaranteed recipient, so central is not the midpoint. Where an Active application carries several enumerated readings, central takes their plain average.
methodology.laneUpperRule: Skills never overlap and every activation stacks.
methodology.laneUpperTargeting: Every unresolved skill target resolves to the most favourable recipient.
methodology.frozenCutoffs: Frozen Member cutoffs, by progression lens

rollCompare.seeIfStrengthens: See whether this card strengthens your saved team
rollCompare.verdictForcedMember: Required Member comparison · signed swap difference
rollCompare.verdictForcedDetail: This run requires the picked card as a Member. Acquiring it is optional: you can keep your owned team instead.
rollCompare.verdictNeutralOrWorse: The swap is neutral or worse under the model.
rollCompare.verdictNotUsed: The second run did not use the picked card as a Member or Leader Outfit.
rollCompare.verdictBoth: The second run fielded the picked card as a Member and led with its Leader Outfit.
rollCompare.verdictMember: The second run included the picked card in its five-Member lineup.
rollCompare.verdictLeader: The second run led with the picked card's Leader Outfit.

rollCompare.disclosureRelative: Relative team value, not a projected Live Score.
rollCompare.allSlotsOpen: All Member slots open; saved Oshi restriction ignored
rollCompare.allSlotsLockedWarning: All five Members are locked. New cards can only improve the Leader Outfit. Uncheck this option to search for Member replacements; your saved team settings will be kept.
rollCompare.bloomNote: Owned cards keep their saved Bloom levels. Every unowned card is tested at Bloom 0; a fresh copy may lose to your invested cards.
rollCompare.targetsDisclosure: Team utility across 30 Expert charts; Board and Connect effects excluded. Bounded searches find upgrades, but do not prove the global best. Small differences may be a tie. For non-upgrades, signed differences show the best found team requiring that card as a Member. You can keep your owned team instead.
